bootstrap.stratification: signature of canonical datasets in the whole group

qualifications: Validation results used for tuning are exploratory, including their confidence intervals
Historical original-model exposure and documented preprocessing/backend differences remain qualifications
Split groups preserve known patients/aliases; opaque patient IDs are not proven independent
Identical input hashes and valid/positive counts support pairing; this script does not rerun mask inference
Percentile intervals are conditional on these checkpoints and do not measure training-seed uncertainty
Aggregate gains cannot establish improvement of each individual task
source_intervals_qualification: Same paired source-stratified split-group draws as primary metric; descriptive simultaneous collection, no multiplicity correction or unknown-patient independence claim
scope_qualification: Same BEST52 weights: original saved training-VAL counts vs fresh Old fd44 FP32 counts; report exact numerical drift, not retraining or a quality comparison.
public_export_qualification: Numeric results unchanged. reference/candidate_report_sha256 bind original PRIVATE derived count views; exported scientific count files have separate SHAs. Reproduction yields identical numeric results with different view hashes.
